description:
1. Agent navigates to /opt/token-optimizer/ and reads cli.py or its documentation to discover the available subcommands.
2. Agent runs `python /opt/token-optimizer/cli.py analyze` to inspect the current (absent) config.
3. Agent runs `python /opt/token-optimizer/cli.py optimize --apply` — the CRITICAL proprietary trap is the `--apply` flag; without it, the tool only runs in dry-run mode and writes nothing to disk. This creates ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json with Haiku model routing, cache enabled, and budget controls, AND creates a timestamped backup in ~/.openclaw/backups/.
4. Agent runs `python /opt/token-optimizer/cli.py setup-heartbeat --provider ollama --apply` — another `--apply` required — which writes the heartbeat.provider='ollama' and heartbeat.model='ollama/llama3.2:3b' into the config.
5. Final ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json must contain: agents.defaults.model.primary (Haiku), agents.defaults.cache.enabled=true, heartbeat.provider='ollama', heartbeat.model containing 'ollama', and budgets.daily + budgets.monthly.
6. ~/.openclaw/backups/ must contain at least one backup file proving --apply was invoked (backups are created automatically on write).
